start: Profile → Settings → Help and feedback; three questions sent before from this phone

user_sees: A 'Quick answer' card tagged 'automatic' with 'Did this solve it?' Yes / No
Under a question with no AI answer: 'The MettleUp team will reply here.'
Each 'Reply from the MettleUp team' in time order, 'New' on unseen ones

start: Any screen; the round tab shows a red dot with '1'

user_sees: Sheet titled 'The MettleUp team answered you' opened straight on that question, the reply marked 'New'
must_not: A question with no new reply shown in this view

steps.action: Tap 'Ask something new', then 'See your questions and answers'
user_sees: Sheet titled 'Your questions' with every kept question
must_not: The red dot still on after the reply was shown

start: Fresh install; Profile → Settings → Help and feedback

user_sees: 'Questions you send from this phone show here, with their answers.'

steps.action: Turn the internet off and send a question
user_sees: The question is taken off the list; its words stay in the box
must_not: A question stuck on 'Waiting for the answer' for ever

user_sees: 'Got it. We reply as soon as we can.'
'You said this did not solve it. The MettleUp team will reply here.'
must_not: A promise of a reply with no question kept

start: Help and feedback sheet; a question just sent

steps.action: Close the sheet at once and open 'Your questions'
user_sees: 'Waiting for the answer. It usually takes a few seconds.' for at most 2 minutes

steps.action: After the team replies, open the list
Close and open the list again
must_not: The red dot back for the same reply
A reply marked read before it was on screen

user_sees: Only the questions sent from this install, with their answers and replies
must_not: Questions shown to the gym's owner or staff
Questions of another install or member

steps.action: Erase all data, then open the list
user_sees: 'Questions you send from this phone show here, with their answers.'
must_not: Old questions still listed after the erase
